newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000 tonnes soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000 tonnes soybeans.

text.p: The Kaohsiung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will hold an invitation-only tender on Friday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. soybeans, traders said.
The tender specifies that the shipment has an optional September or October delivery, traders said.

Traders said the tender, if completed with a purchase, could lure rival Taiwan soy buyers into the market, particularly the unaffiliated Taichung division of the Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association.
Traders said the Kaohsiung soybean buying group changed its normal open public tender to invitation-only in a bid to keep the highly competitive Taichung division from knowing.
"The Kaohsiung division has maintained a high level of secrecy on the tender," a trader said. "Only a handful of suppliers were invited."
The Taichung division comprises Sino Japan Feed Corp, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed, Fwu Sow Grain and Tay Shan.
